output.title: HTTP01 Ingress PathType change may affect this cert-manager
output.content: This environment has cert-manager installed with the config key `global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole` present, indicating HTTP challenges are relevant to its setup. The v1.18.0 change modifies how `PathType` is set in Ingress routes created for ACME HTTP01 challenges. Inspect your ACME Issuer/ClusterIssuer configurations to confirm whether HTTP01 is enabled; check any Ingress resources that cert-manager creates for challenge solving; and verify your Ingress controller's compatibility with `PathType: Exact` (the evidence notes this affects some non-standard implementations).
